# Narrative Frame Link

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NarrativeFrameLink`](gmeow-NarrativeFrameLink.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NarrativeFrameLink>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified relator that binds a source narrative frame, a target narrative frame, and the relation type between them into a single node. The canonical form when the specific frame-to-frame relation must itself be a node (e.g. to attach provenance, confidence, temporal scope, or standpoint); the flat shortcuts are [`gmeow:hasNarrativeFrameRelation`](../properties/gmeow-hasNarrativeFrameRelation.md) and [`gmeow:relatesToFrame`](../properties/gmeow-relatesToFrame.md). Structurally the [`Tagging`](gmeow-Tagging.md)/NameUsage idiom wearing a different hat.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NarrativeFrameLink`](gmeow-NarrativeFrameLink.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
